column2: somebody is in my kitchen right now, no idea who, im hiding in the hall bathroom
my door got busted open and a man is inside yelling, i'm under the bed with my brother
i can hear a stranger walking through our living room, we're hiding in my closet
burglars are in the house, we're locked in the upstairs bathroom
someone forced open my window and is inside, whispering from inside my closet
a guy broke in and is looking for us, we're in the attic
theres an unknown man in my backyard trying the patio door and i'm home alone hiding
there are two men in our living room with crowbars, we're hiding upstairs
my stalker is inside my apartment, i'm hiding in the bathtub
home invasion right now, my parents are tied up, i'm in the crawlspace
our car went into the flooded creek and the water is up to the dash
the car is sinking in the canal, i can't get my kid's car seat unbuckled
i'm trapped in the car, flood water is coming through the doors
my wife's car slid into the retention pond and she's still inside
water is rushing over the road and my car is being pushed toward the river
my car is underwater to the windows, i'm stuck inside
the flash flood is filling our house, we're on the kitchen counters
we're stuck in the attic, the flood water is rising up the stairs
water is flooding our first floor fast and my mom can't walk
we're on the roof and the water keeps coming up
our kitchen's burning and the smoke alarm won't stop
my bedroom is filling with smoke and i can't open the door
the fire from the neighbor's yard spread to our fence and garage
my little sister's dress caught fire at the birthday party
my dad isn't breathing and his face is gray
my toddler is choking and turning purple
mom's face is drooping, her words come out wrong
my brother overdosed, he's not responding
an hour ago i swallowed an entire bottle of pills
my boyfriend is beating me and won't let me leave
my 1 year old ate a detergent pod
my son is missing at the county fair, searched everywhere
gas leak smell in the apartment and my neighbor passed out
the barn roof collapsed on my uncle
my daughter got swept away by the waves at the beach
my coworker is pinned under a forklift
my friend fell into a ravine on the hike and isn't answering
a bus hit a woman crossing and she's bleeding heavily
my son got electrocuted by the outlet and isn't breathing
i have a gun and i want to kill myself
